name: A.F. Johnson Millwork Co.
old_description: A.F. Johnson Millwork Company has delivered architectural millwork excellence for nine decades. As an AWI Premium Quality Certified member since 1989, we bring unmatched expertise to commercial projects nationwide. Our West Des Moines facility houses 25 skilled professionals, including designers, CNC experts, and master cabinetmakers, using advanced Microvellum and AutoCAD technology.
about:
A.F. Johnson Millwork Co. has operated from West Des Moines, Iowa since its founding in 1932 by Swedish immigrant Adolph F. Johnson. The company remains family-owned, with Johnson's son Richard "Dick" Johnson joining the business and passing the same exacting standard to subsequent generations. What began as a shop building out national chain stores across the Midwest grew into a dedicated architectural millwork facility.

The 25-person team — designers, engineers, CNC programmers, and master cabinetmakers — produces custom architectural millwork, casework, solid-surface fabrications, and upholstered seating. Work flows through a single West Des Moines plant equipped with CNC machining centers, Microvellum manufacturing software, and AutoCAD drafting, handling projects valued from $50,000 to seven figures. Services span concept development, detailed 3D renderings, fabrication, finishing, and nationwide installation.

Primary markets include retail, corporate, hospitality, healthcare, education, religious, and government sectors. The firm collaborates directly with architects, designers, and general contractors on commercial projects that represent roughly 95 percent of its workload, with select high-end residential commissions rounding out the portfolio.

The company cites its AWI Premium Quality Certification (held since 1989), nine decades of continuous operation, and the integration of advanced digital tools with traditional craftsmanship as its core differentiators. Every project carries a full one-year warranty per AWI specifications, backed by multiple in-process quality checkpoints.
